remarks: Diamond in the Rough! This stately colonial is brimming with potential and ready to be restored to its former grandeur. Nestled on a private lot, the home offers a peaceful setting with ample space for everyone. Boasting over 3,800 sq ft, this spacious residence features 5 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms, along with gleaming hardwood floors and a variety of rooms designed for comfortable living. The main level includes a classic kitchen, formal dining room, and a living room with a cozy fireplace. An additional room on this level provides extra space for entertaining, relaxing, or creating your dream layout. Just three steps up from the main level, you'll find a dramatic family room with soaring ceilings and expansive views of the backyard-perfect for gatherings or quiet evenings. Continue up another short flight of stairs to discover the private bedroom wing, complete with five generously sized bedrooms, a full hall bath, and a primary suite with its own en-suite bath. On the lower level, a finished bonus room offers even more versatility-ideal for a TV room, playroom, office, or whatever suits your lifestyle. Don't miss this rare opportunity to bring your vision to life in a home with timeless charm and room to grow!
